card_pick.why: One 3D cube turn, in from the right, on all three title cards. Fit: the verb of this video is ROTATE (buy the bottoms, sell the pumps, rotate; the loop), so each chapter turns up as the next face of one object, and the one marquee spin answers it. Variety: flip is BLOCKED (pieverse); among the Safe moves cube is the least recently used (quant, 2026-11-06; slide ran on canton, 2026-11-10); book-flip and swap are fresh but need the unverified canvas render flag, not a risk to take under a standing approval. Tagged hand:cube-3d because the installed @remotion/transitions 4.0.462 ships no cube presentation (comp-build section 6): the hand-rolled rotateY turn, about 11 frames in, held to the end of the pause, never turned back out. Each card is its own pause scene, never the spine in TransitionSeries; readable = 1.5 s pause minus the 0.4 s turn = 1.1 s.

face_glitch_pick.why: register decides: the warm radial flash, 0.38 s each side of the cut, speaks the same light as the orange Bitcoin sign of the city-look face scenes and the gold accent of the hook, and it is silent. The music plan lands every face edge on a music move or on nothing (the drops at 16.27 and 53.36, no move at F4, no hit under the goal line, the last tone on the sign-off), so a Blocks Max glitch would add 14 baked digital hits the plan does not want. It is also an overlay on the live layers, so the bg-swap clips need no frozen face node. On all 14 face edges. Advisory slot: film burn also ran on the last two videos, see open questions

melt_pick.why: MELT/RGB, the chromatic channel reform, in its soft recipe (soft-2 full and soft-short-2, two never-used ids): the least recently used melt look (quant, 2026-11-06); MELT/Equidistant ran on AI vs ML, inside the last three videos. The soft falloff suits light-theme charts and subtle beds

spin_pick.why: SPIN/Center Swinging, a flat centre spin with a pendulum settle: the frame turns like the loop it brings in and the swing lands on the words swing trading software. Used once (kcc20, 2026-10-22), outside the last three videos; Center Ease ran on AI vs ML and the 3D looks ran on reset, quant and canton

face_leak_set.why: Three punch points (F6 470.567, F7 569.867, F8 589.5), three ids, one look, each used once in order. Fit comes first: every join sits 0.63 to 0.87 s from a face edge that carries a film burn, so only a 0.4 s leak clears the burn; the five never-used leaks (soft-3, soft-4, soft-5, soft-7, soft-9) are all 1.44 s and would run into the burn or past the face. Soft Short is the gentlest 0.4 s look, right for a leak that sits a few frames from a burn on calm lines. None is BLOCKED (pieverse used no leak); these three are the least recently used ids of the look (growth-scale-up, 2026-10-28), outside the last three videos.

melt_spin_budget.note: Three marquees in a 10 minute video, one per body chapter: the CH2 payoff (C-SPACEX to C1 FINAL, melt), the CH3 return (D-ROTATE to the EVAA run, melt), the CH4 system reveal (C16-ZOOM to THE LOOP, spin). CH1 runs on music drops and two glitch hits; CH5, the drone chapter, takes none. The fourth cue sheet candidate (D-ENTRIES to C22B at 505.90) stays a quiet swap.

consistency_check: ONE card move (hand:cube-3d) on all 3 title cards. ONE face pick (hand:film-burn) on all 14 face edges; the 3 punch points carry one leak look (Soft Short, 3 ids). ONE melt look (MELT/RGB, soft recipe, 2 rows) and ONE spin look (SPIN/Center Swinging, 1 row), all three on chart or diagram marquees, full frame, sound trimmed under the voice. ONE glitch family for stills (Cinematic Bad Signal: Max in the hook, Short after it, 5 rows, no id twice); the two CH5 stills take the quiet cross-warp and IMG-3 enters under the F4 burn. Every text card, chart, diagram and receipt swap is the quiet hand:xfade-scale; Envato video is hand:fade; the headline stack and the clip montage are hard cuts; the whiteboard uses its paper sheet. Every move is expressible on the one continuous spine: overlays animate their own in and out, only the 3 card scenes are self-contained.
open_questions: Face pick repeats (advisory, not gated): film burn ran on future-of-software-engineers and pieverse. Kept because it is silent and warm and the music plan wants no hit on the face edges; the Blocks Max glitch (last on a face 2026-10-27) would put 14 baked glitch sounds on them. Say so if you want the glitch on faces.

Card move: cube, the least recently used Safe move, hand-rolled because the package ships none. Slide (rmn) is the alternative; book-flip and swap have never been used but need the canvas render flag nobody has verified.

AI stills: Cinematic Bad Signal (last used 2026-09-28) on 5 of 8 stills, as the cue sheet expects. The never-used VHS and Invert families were weighed and left: VHS reads as old tape in a video about this month, Invert is a hard strobe against light-theme cards. In CH5 the two stills (IMG-7, IMG-8) take the silent cross-warp under the drone, and IMG-3 enters under the F4 film burn. Say so if you want a glitch on every still.

Marquee not taken: the melt candidate at 8:25.9 (D-ENTRIES to C22B). C22B enters as a nearly empty page and draws its loop 2.3 s later, so the melt would have nothing to reform into. If you want CH5 to carry one, the diagram would have to enter on its first loop.

Transition sounds: the mixer lays the baked sound of every library row and has no mute. Starting trims on the rows (sfx_rel_db): the two melts -9 dB (your call on this same melt sound in reset), the spin -6, the three post-intro glitches -6, the two hook glitches at the default, the three light leaks inaudible (-60) because each sits on the last words of its line.
